captions.detailed: An upright, tall casino slot machine cabinet colored in deep red with dark brown accents at the top and bottom. On its right side, it features a golden lever handle topped with a spherical white knob. The handle pivots forward and backward on a revolute joint, while the front of the machine is designed to house a three-reel viewing window and a bottom coin tray.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an upright casino slot machine cabinet in CadQuery. The design should feature a tall, rectangular red cabinet with dark brown top/bottom caps, and a side-mounted golden lever handle with a white spherical knob that articulates on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs a tall upright cabinet using a main Box primitive colored red, capped with dark brown Box primitives at the top and bottom. The side handle is constructed by combining a gold-colored Cylinder for the pivoting base, a thin Cylinder for the lever rod, and a white Sphere for the knob. These components are structured into an ArticulatedObject system with a revolute joint connecting the handle assembly to the cabinet.
